subject: Shiny Server hosting on the Web interface slow

messages.author: 98d2aca11b7eab89
messages.subject: Shiny Server hosting on the Web interface slow
parts:
Hi,

I have built a shiny application to automate some of our processes and when i run them in R studio - the queries are returning pretty fast. When i  move it to shiny server and host on the web interface, the queries are running much slower compared to r studio. When i just copy all the files back from my source to /srv, the first time the response is really fast and this goes on reducing as we execute the jobs. Any reason for this?

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server hosting on the Web interface slow
parts:
Do you have multiple simultaneous browser sessions running against the one application, when it's running on Shiny Server? Could it be contention between those sessions that's slowing it down? Or even with one user it's really slow?

Does it get slow across the board, or does it feel like it is sluggish some moments and fast in others?
